instrument: ChatGPT connected-GitHub blind-memory probe with bounded receipt-family de-dup preflight

preflight.control_observation: P012 explicitly treated realized freight as a contract state machine and stopped before clause/arbitration/broker cataloguing; therefore P142 must not rediscover generic fixture/laytime/demurrage/offhire administration. P013 owns claims-evidence formation, P044/P065 own insurance/claims/security, and P045 owns arrest/liens/security/judicial availability. The useful residue is private dispute-forum and collective casualty-cost/security structure, if it survives without clause/case detail.

candidate_new_categories.label: private_maritime_dispute_forum_pathway_state
candidate_new_categories.memory: A commercial maritime dispute can move into a private dispute-resolution pathway distinct from ordinary contract administration and from court/arrest enforcement. Research should preserve the forum/pathway state and known-time without assuming jurisdiction, governing law or outcome.

candidate_new_categories.label: collective_casualty_cost_allocation_security_state
candidate_new_categories.memory: Some maritime casualty contexts can create a collective cost-allocation and security-coordination state across vessel/cargo interests that is structurally different from a single bilateral claim or insurance policy response. Exact general-average rules, declarations, contributions and securities require Evidence.

candidate_new_categories.label: salvage_assistance_reward_security_pathway_state
candidate_new_categories.memory: Emergency assistance to property at maritime risk can create a distinct post-casualty remuneration/security/dispute pathway rather than merely a technical recovery event. Exact salvage entitlement, contract, award, security and legal effect require Evidence.

candidate_new_categories.label: transport_document_contract_chain_role_alignment
candidate_new_categories.memory: Cargo carriage may involve a chain of transport documents and contractual roles whose alignment can matter to claim/dispute reconstruction. Exact privity, incorporation, title, carrier identity and legal duty cannot be inferred from Memory.

candidate_new_categories.label: contract_dispute_security_parallel_state
candidate_new_categories.memory: Commercial performance dispute, claims evidence, insurance response and security/enforcement can proceed on partially separate clocks; historical reconstruction should not collapse them into one settled/not-settled flag.

candidate_new_categories.label: private_forum_to_judicial_enforcement_transition
candidate_new_categories.memory: A private dispute-resolution state and a judicial asset-security/enforcement state can be distinct even when they concern the same commercial dispute; exact enforceability and procedure are Evidence-only.

candidate_new_categories.label: contractual_risk_allocation_interface_map
candidate_new_categories.memory: A useful source-discovery map distinguishes operational performance allocation, cargo evidence, insurance transfer and legal/security enforcement rather than treating all as one generic contract-risk layer.

useful_refinements.label: P012_contract_state_machine_extension_to_dispute
useful_refinements.memory: P012 already owns fixture through operational timestamps, time allocation and settlement; P142 only extends the trajectory where unresolved performance moves into dispute/forum/security states.

useful_refinements.label: claims_evidence_precedes_forum_pathway
useful_refinements.memory: P013's measurement/custody evidence state remains upstream of later dispute resolution; a forum state does not replace the evidence lineage.

useful_refinements.label: insurance_response_parallel_not_semantic_owner
useful_refinements.memory: P044/P065 own coverage/claim/security/settlement Memory. P142 treats insurance as a parallel interface and does not claim a new insurance category.

useful_refinements.label: judicial_asset_security_boundary
useful_refinements.memory: P045 owns arrest/liens/security/judicial-sale legal availability; private arbitration/dispute routing is distinct only before or alongside that judicial enforcement layer.

useful_refinements.label: general_average_like_state_not_verified_legal_conclusion
useful_refinements.memory: A collective casualty-cost/security research state should be represented as a source-discovery hypothesis, never as a legal conclusion that general average applies.

useful_refinements.label: salvage_like_state_not_verified_entitlement
useful_refinements.memory: An assistance/reward/security research state must not imply a valid salvage claim, award or entitlement.

duplicates.label: ownership_registry_manager_identity
duplicates.memory: Owned by P046; P141 re-recalled this older family.

duplicates.label: named_clause_form_tribunal_case_or_jurisdiction_catalogue
duplicates.memory: Exact clause/form/forum/case enumeration is legal/source archaeology, not a blind-memory category.

reviewed_no_specific_memory: exact charterparty or bill-of-lading clauses, incorporation, governing law, carrier identity or liabilities
exact arbitration agreement, tribunal, seat, procedure, award, enforcement or settlement
exact general-average adjustment, declaration, contribution, guarantee/bond, security or legal applicability
exact salvage contract, entitlement, award, security, limitation or court/arbitral result
named casualty/dispute/claim parties, chronology, amounts, fault, liability, coverage or current status
negative_space: claim-scoped known-time reconstruction of private dispute forum transitions
historical general-average/security pathways after major casualty
exact contract-chain role relationships for named voyages/cargoes
stop_reason: Campaign-wide preflight removes generic chartering, claims-evidence, insurance/security and judicial-enforcement rediscovery. The bounded residue is private dispute-forum routing plus collective casualty-cost/security and salvage-assistance pathways; further detail becomes exact contract/legal/case archaeology.
epistemic_boundary: Memory-only structural source-discovery orientation and not legal, insurance, claims, chartering or operational advice. No clause, liability, coverage, general-average applicability, salvage entitlement, forum jurisdiction, award, security, fault or named-party fact is established.
